# talos-cluster

A Talos cluster in docker, on a network talosctl makes.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| configPatches | list of string | `[]` | Machine config patches applied to every node, each a JSON or YAML document.  This is how Talos is configured at all: registry mirrors, CA trust, nameservers, API server arguments and the CNI choice are all machine config rather than command line flags.  |
| cpus | string | `"2.0"` | CPUs per node. |
| exposedPorts | list of string | `[]` | Host port mappings talosctl publishes, as `host:container`. |
| image | null or string | `null` | Talos node image. Null takes talosctl's own default for its version. |
| instanceName | string | *(required)* | What talosctl calls the cluster's containers. Distinct from `name` for the reason k3d's is: two labs may each hold a cluster called `app` on one docker host, and the container names would collide.  |
| kubernetesVersion | string | `"1.31.4"` | Kubelet image tag, written major.minor.patch. Pinned, not floating. |
| memory | string | `"2.0GiB"` | Memory per node. |
| mounts | list of string | `[]` | Bind mounts on every node, as `host:container`. |
| name | string | *(required)* | Cluster name, as members and the kubeconfig see it. Required. |
| podSubnet | string | `"10.244.0.0/16"` | Pod CIDR. A decision, written down; see the k3d floe. |
| serviceSubnet | string | `"10.96.0.0/12"` | Service CIDR. Same reasoning as `podSubnet`. |
| subnet | string | `"10.5.0.0/24"` | Subnet talosctl makes for the cluster's own network.  Talos gets one of its own because talosctl will not join a network it did not make. Must not overlap the lab's, which the lab's own checks do not cover — this network is not one the lab creates.  |
| version | string | `"1.31"` | Kubernetes minor version this cluster answers as, written major.minor — the schema set manifests are typed against.  Distinct from `kubernetesVersion`, which is a kubelet image tag and needs a patch level. That one is not a version anything validates against; this one is not a tag anything can pull.  |
| workers | unsigned integer, meaning >=0 | `1` | Worker nodes.  At least one unless nothing has to be scheduled. A Talos control plane keeps the standard NoSchedule taint, unlike a k3d server node, so a cluster with none has nowhere to run a workload — and the symptom is every Pod Pending rather than anything naming the taint.  |

## Provides

| promise | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |

## Emits

| alias | kind | what it carries |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | catallaxy.cluster | How a cluster is created and who fronts it — the descriptor `cata` builds it from. |
